success: A system emits an autonomous stop, delivered semantic goal matches requested symbol and target color, full quaternion error <=0.16 rad at that stop, and no prior drop. A reach alone never terminates. No extra hold duration is imposed after stop.
primary_denominator: Complete matched triplets without service errors or measured request wall latency >120s in any of the three arms. Exclude the same (repeat, seed, case) from all three. Preserve raw denominator as mandatory companion. No performance-based exclusions or reruns.
physics: 30Hz control, 15Hz RGB-D, 3Hz frozen pose verifier. Physics continues through real inference; response delivery aligned to max(actual completion, ceil(wall latency*30)).
startup: fixed green through original V3, without fabricating semantic binding
drop_rule: Unchanged environment semantic_metrics.dropped; source frozen below.

arms.astra: gpt-6-astra low reasoning, existing tool prompt, learned RGB semantic memory, own stop proposal gated by frozen pose head
arms.rule: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 4bit, frozen periodic inventory/rule supervisor, at most six actual model calls including language parse, plus shared frozen pose head autonomous stopping
arms.latent: Same Qwen backbone with existing latent_v2 LoRA and continuous goal head; preserve continuous 768D goal into student; text-only requested-symbol parser for bookkeeping; shared frozen pose head autonomous stopping

stop_comparability: Identical evaluator success predicate. Baselines differ in stop proposal policy by design. Local baseline stop is supplied by a learned pose head, not claimed to be native VLM stop prediction. Pose head does not check semantic binding; independent scorer checks it.
frozen_pose_warning: Existing pose head has not passed its original 90% precision deployment gate. This evaluation measures the fixed experimental systems and does not certify that head.
shared: Frozen student, action scale, original V3 waiting controller, initialization, startup, pose head, camera and horizon. Same RGB semantic frontend executes in all arms; only Astra consumes its historical memory.
change_policy: Do not change metric, thresholds, prompts, weights, cases, horizon or budget during or after this run. Implementation failure stops the run; any corrected protocol must get a new version with all invalidated records retained.
